stories.headline: Google launches 'Gemini Spark', a 24/7 personal AI agent, in India
stories.why_rising: Major agentic-AI product launch aimed squarely at Indian Gemini Pro/Ultra users, giving Google a fresh consumer-AI foothold in one of its biggest markets just days before this collection window.

stories.headline: TCS, Infosys, Coforge and other IT stocks rally sharply as fears over an 'AI spending slowdown' ease
stories.why_rising: Nifty IT was the top sectoral gainer with multi-day gains up to 4-10% for TCS/Infosys/Coforge, a major swing for India's largest tech-services export sector tied directly to global AI-capex sentiment and the US Fed decision.

stories.headline: Tata Electronics and ASML reportedly in talks to make precision chip-equipment components in India
stories.why_rising: Fresh Aug 1 report of a possible new manufacturing tie-up (beyond their May 2026 ecosystem partnership) to build ASML's high-precision components locally, deepening India's semiconductor supply-chain push.

stories.headline: Bengaluru restaurants threaten to boycott Swiggy and Zomato from August 15 over commissions and deep discounting
stories.why_rising: Restaurant associations set a hard Aug 15 deadline, escalating a commission/discounting dispute with India's two dominant food-delivery platforms; picked up by at least five outlets in the past few days.

stories.headline: New UPI privacy rules and CKYC 2.0 digital-KYC overhaul take effect from August 1, 2026
stories.why_rising: Nationwide fintech/digital-infrastructure rule changes kick in right at the start of this window, affecting UPI data-sharing practices and India's central KYC registry used across banking and payment apps.

stories.headline: Wave of smartphone launches hits India in August: Google Pixel 11 series, Redmi Note 17, Vivo S2, Poco M8 Power
stories.why_rising: Fresh Aug 1 roundup consolidating a cluster of flagship and mid-range launches converging on the India market this month, led by the Pixel 11 series.

stories.headline: Indian startup pipeline heats up: Arboreal raises ~Rs 230 crore, Atomberg lines up a ~Rs 2,000 crore IPO, Shadowfax profit jumps 8x
stories.why_rising: Snapshot of a fast-moving funding and IPO pipeline right at the edge of the window, signalling more tech-adjacent Indian listings and rounds incoming through the rest of 2026.

stories.headline: Apple's India antitrust fight over App Store rules keeps escalating; CCI rebuffs Apple's delay attempts
stories.why_rising: Apple has accused India's competition regulator of 'copy-pasting' rivals' claims while the CCI has warned it will proceed regardless — a marquee, still-unresolved Big Tech regulatory fight in India worth watching for a ruling.
